 tank 3 tons
Oil drainage pump.

Cleaning articles ( fluid, rags,

Make sure that the lifting equipment is in good condition.
Get out the pump from the sump.

Check the condition of carrying handle, lifting eyes, 
 chains and wire cables.
Check that the guide bars are vertical.

Rinse the pump thoroughly with clean water before starting 
 work.
Clean the pass of cooling pump system.

Check the pump casing and impeller ( clearance not exceed 
 2 mm. )

Dismantle the power and control cable from the top of 
 pump (38) by electric sections.

Drainage the oil from the oil casing using a small special 
 pump (48) and check the oil condition see figure (1)

Dismantle the parts of the pump in sequences as shown in 
 figure (1)
Inspect the shaft of pump (77)
Inspect the impeller (81)

Inspect the wear ring , replace it with a new one if 
 necessary (100)

Replace the lower and upper roller bearing with a new one 
 (26 , 27)

Replace the lower and upper mechanical seals with a new 
 one (57 , 66)
Paint the inner and outer side of pump.
Inspect the electrical sensors by electric sections

Erect the pump in opposite sequence of dismantling 
 and usE a new group of gaskets and sealing

Erect the power and control cables in the top of pump by 
 electric sections
Fill the oil casing with a new oil and plugged it.

Check the cable entry and make sure that the cable clamps 
 are tight.
Check the pipes and valves.

Lay down the pump in it is seat and sure that it is in 
 proper position.
Joint electrical terminals of cables by electric sections.
Check the function of operation of the pump.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, to be performed every three years or every 24000 hours. as indicated 
by Y3 / H2400 in the title block.
There are two drainage pumps one in the North main sump tank and the other in 
the South main sump tank and their function to drain the main sump tanks.
Technical Specifications:
Rated power : 30kw 
Rated speed : 1450 rpm
Rated flow : 20 Liter/sec Delivery head 
: 46 m.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd Elnabi 
Ibrahim, tested by eng. Al sayed Ibrahim Al ashmony, accepted by general 
director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman, approved by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Yonis; 
Head Sector of Aswan ( 1 & 2 ) Power Station and certified by eng. Mohamed 
Osama Soliman HPGC inspection and quality control general director.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
